reel_angle.fan_question: Who cost United Pochettino's first win: Lammens or the referee?
reel_angle.data_answer: Both Sporting goals came straight from Lammens errors: the second penalty he conceded (0.79 xG) and the 80th-minute dropped cross (0.46 xG), 1.25 of Sporting's 2.46 xG between them. The referee ruled out two United goals. Lammens' shot-stopping was fine (penalty save, +0.69 goals prevented on ESPN); the errors were the problem. BBC users rated him 2.91, lowest on the pitch.
reel_angle.fan_heat: not measured: Reddit returned 404 in keyless RSS mode. Trusted-outlet framing: ESPN, Guardian and Sky Sports all put Lammens' error in their headlines; BBC, ESPN and the Guardian all criticise the referee.
reel_angle.hook_angle: Ten minutes from Pochettino's first win. Then his keeper dropped it.
reel_angle.why: No Reddit signal, so best_angle t1 (strong: official + 2 outlets) ties straight to the data's biggest story (Lammens' errors behind both Sporting goals), with the referee row as the counter-argument for the outro debate.
